summary_1line: Ravana learns of Meghanada’s powerful sacrifices, hears that Madhu abducted their kinswoman, and marches with a vast army to confront him.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the Nikumbhila grove, Meghanada stands in black antelope skin beside blazing sacrificial altars as Ravana embraces him amid rows of ritual posts.
Ravana, eyes red with fury, commands his chariot while an immense host of rakshasas mounted on serpents, buffalo, and horses surges behind him.
Kumbhinasi falls at Ravana’s feet in Madhupura, begging him not to slay her husband Madhu as the demon king raises her up.
